text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: GPU mmap failure rate > 8% in pool=dedicated-eu-1, metric=gpu.mmap.failures, window=60s, severity=page

pagerduty: Incident page fired to oncall: leo (1/2) — reason: repeated `cudaHostAlloc` mmap failures, autoscale pressure, >200 alloc fails/min

leo: acked — taking it. digging in now.

maria: seeing similar in logs for model=redwood-13b-quant, fallback to cpu happening for some shards. latency spikes on routes /v1/generate.

leo: i'm attaching the short log snippet: ```
[2026-03-14T18:12:30Z] alloc failed: cudaHostAlloc mmap failed: errno=12
[2026-03-14T18:12:30Z] kvcache evict start pool=dedicated-eu-1
[2026-03-14T18:12:31Z] runtime: fallback started for request_id=6a1f...
```

ajay: checking node-level memory map table — one node (gpu-12) showing repeated `mmap` ENOMEM after recent kernel update. Could be driver/patch regression.

katie: quick customer impact: dashboards show error-rate up to 11.8% for EU region, p95 latency x3. Roughly 2% of total requests are hitting hard OOM and falling back to CPU causing queuing.

leo: initial mitigation: draining pool node gpu-12, moving traffic to standby nodes in eu-2, and enabling aggressive prefix KV cache eviction to free pinned host memory. Doing drain now.

sre-bot: deploybot: started cordon on gpu-12, draining in progress (10 live tasks -> 0). ETA ~90s.

maria: adding temporary route policy: prefer:eu-2,fallback:cpu=false for production traffic — to avoid more fallbacks. will monitor.

ajay: inspected dmesg — kernel logs show: `mmap failed: order: -1, lowmem-reserve depleted` after patch 5.19.14 -> suspect vm.overcommit settings?

leo: action checklist: 1) drain gpu-12 (in progress) 2) bump pool capacity (autoscaling + add two warm nodes) 3) escalate to infra for possible kernel rollback 4) notify customers if sustained >10% error for 15min

katie: i've drafted a short incident note for CSMs: "We're investigating GPU host memory mapping failures affecting EU inference. Some requests are being served from CPU fallback causing higher latency. Next update in 15m." want review?

maria: LGTM. add known affected models list: redwood-13b-quant, redwood-7b-int4.

leo: drain complete. gpu-12 quarantined and will be rebooted with driver rollback candidate. Starting scale-up: requested 2 nodes from pool autoscaler.

pagerduty: leo acknowledged page at 18:12:48, escalation paused.

ajay: manual kernel rollback queued on one repro node in staging, testing mmap replication now. if it reproduces, we should schedule a rolling fix to prod.

sre-bot: autoscaler: provisioning +2 nodes in dedicated-eu-1 (expected ready 120s).

katie: monitoring: error-rate trending down to 4.1% after reroute, p95 still ~2.6x baseline. will keep watch.

leo: customer-impact estimate: ~1.6% of requests failed (retries applied) with increased latency for additional ~1.8% that hit CPU fallback. No data exfiltration, no long-term loss. recommended to set severity=major until stable.

maria: created incident record INC-2026-0314-GPU-MMAP and added runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-mmap-failures

leo: handoff plan: i'll stay on for next 30m unless condition improves. if error-rate <2% and p95 <1.3x baseline by 18:45Z, we can close pager and mark mitigation complete.

ajay: update from staging: rollback fixed the repro — mmap failures gone under load. propagating rollback to canary nodes now.

katie: public status update posted to customers (no ETA) — will escalate if rolling rollback causes regressions.

pagerduty: page resolved by leo at 18:35:20 — condition improved, error-rate down to 0.9% after canary rollback.

leo: final notes: root cause appears to be interaction between kernel 5.19.14 and our host pinned allocations under heavy kvcache churn; mitigation was node quarantine + kernel rollback and temporary traffic reroute. follow-ups: 1) infra to schedule kernel rollback across prod nodes 2) add mmap error threshold to auto-evict policy earlier 3) regression test in canary for future kernel bumps.

maria: filing follow-up doc in #postmortems and adding customer-impact timeline.

katie: handing off to night oncall @maria for monitoring. handing off notes in INC-2026-0314-GPU-MMAP. :white_check_mark:

maria: taking the handoff. will watch dashboards and keep incident record updated. :eyes:
